incident-bot: :rotating_light: [P0] Elevated 5xx rate observed for embeddings API in us-west-2. Incident ID INC-20260317-01. Alerting SRE and oncall teams. https://status.redwood.example/INC-20260317-01
maria_oncall: I'm taking incident commander. @raj_sre can you own triage?
raj_sre: looking. initial triage: autoscaler failing to provision for pool-dedicated-uswest. allocator returning 429s; infra logs show 'failed to attach gpu queue'. collecting more logs.
sam_ops: noted. Can someone draft a status page update and account-specific reachouts? I'll post once we have wording.
elaine_am: Calyx Systems and Astraeus Labs reporting end-user errors. Calyx is SLA-tiered (24/7). Need tailored comms for both.
noah_support: pulling customer request IDs/examples. Calyx sessionIDs: s-021, s-022 -> consistent 503s. Astraeus shows ~12% failures over last 10m.
raj_sre: root cause: allocator service rate-limited the autoscaler; fallback routing was disabled by a recent rollout. I'm restarting allocator and will scale pool to drain backlog. Patching rollout to re-enable fallback.
maria_oncall: please confirm restart time and whether error rate trending down.
raj_sre: restart triggered at 1719264600. new pods are coming up; traffic shifting. error rate reduced from ~9% -> ~2% in 6m. continuing to monitor.
sam_ops: Draft status page (review please):
```
Status: Partial Degradation — Embeddings API (us-west-2)
Update: We observed elevated 5xx errors starting 2026-03-17 14:12 UTC due to autoscaler/allocator failures. Engineering has applied mitigations (allocator restart and scale-up); error rates are decreasing and traffic is shifting to healthy instances. Impact: Some enterprise customers may experience intermittent request failures and degraded throughput. Next update: 30 minutes.
```
elaine_am: For Calyx (SLA-critical) propose tailored line: "We are actively mitigating an issue causing intermittent request failures for embeddings — Calyx Systems may see degraded throughput; engineering is prioritizing your traffic and will provide an account-specific timeline."
noah_support: Customer email draft for Calyx: "Subject: Service disruption — embeddings API (us-west-2)
Hi Calyx team — We're investigating intermittent request failures affecting embeddings. Our engineers have applied mitigations; error rates are falling. We will update within 30 minutes and provide a post-incident report. If you need immediate assistance, reply to this thread or contact your CSM."
elaine_am: +1. Add escalation phone number and CSM direct line in the email.
maria_oncall: On-call handoff note for next shift: INCIDENT state -> MONITORING. Assigned: raj_sre (primary), sam_ops (communications), elaine_am (customer comms). If error rate >5% for >15m escalate to SRE manager @viktor_sre.
raj_sre: adding runbook snippet to incident doc: 
```
steps:
1) check allocator logs: kubectl -n infra logs deploy/allocator -f
2) if persistent 429s -> restart allocator: kubectl rollout restart deploy/allocator
3) scale pool: kubectl scale deployment/pool-dedicated-uswest --replicas=6
4) if errors persist >10m, enable routing to fallback model variant: route=low-latency-fallback
```
sam_ops: I'll post the status page update and send the Calyx email once you confirm the final line. tagging legal for SLA notification. posting in ~2m.
statusbot: Status page updated: INC-20260317-01 — Partial Degradation — embeddings API (us-west-2)
maria_oncall: thanks. keep updates short and action-focused. attach account list + escalation contacts to the incident doc. @elaine_am please upload contact routing sheet.
elaine_am: uploaded contact sheet: Calyx Systems (primary: csm@calyx.com, phone:+1-555-0101), Astraeus Labs (primary: ops@astraeus.io, phone:+44-20-5555). flagged Calyx as SLA-critical.
noah_support: logging outbound emails/tickets and customer replies. will coordinate post-incident report with SRE/AM.
maria_oncall: incident moved to MONITORING. last check at 1719265400. keeping thread open to watch for regressions; will reopen if error rate spikes.
